verdict.rationale: BILL has a developer portal with v3 API docs, endpoint examples (e.g. POST /v3/vendors), recipes that walk through S&E workflows, and a sandbox for testing without moving real money. That gives a path to trying the API, but no evidence describes an interactive 'try it' reference, and no public OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. missing for 10: explicit interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable/executable examples in the reference, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
